data.long_description:
Located in Sobha Crest Grande within Sobha Hartland, this spacious 3-bedroom plus maid’s apartment offers 1621.04 sqft of well-designed living space, ideal for families seeking comfort and convenience.

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area with large windows allowing plenty of natural light. The modern kitchen is thoughtfully designed with quality finishes and ample storage space. Both bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes, while the maid’s room provides additional flexibility for storage or staff accommodation.
